title: Removal of the Central Maintenance System Flight Deck Display Unit
abstract: Removal of the central maintenance system display unit at the third occupant station, including the configuration read that must be taken before the unit is disconnected.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the central maintenance system display unit at the third occupant station, for replacement or for access to the panel behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: Take the maintenance system configuration read before the unit is disconnected; the display holds the local display configuration and it cannot be recovered from the replacement unit. Stow the third occupant seat and protect the flight deck panel surfaces, which mark easily. The unit is not heavy but it is awkward to hold at arm's length, so use the support bracket rather than holding it while the connectors come off.
sections.procedure: 1. Make the aircraft electrically safe and confirm that the maintenance system is powered down. 2. Stow the third occupant seat and protect the adjacent panel surfaces. 3. Connect the maintenance terminal and read the display configuration. 4. Save the configuration read to the operator maintenance system. CAUTION: DO NOT DISCONNECT THE DISPLAY BEFORE THE CONFIGURATION READ IS SAVED. THE LOCAL DISPLAY CONFIGURATION CANNOT BE RECOVERED FROM THE REPLACEMENT UNIT. 5. Release the quarter-turn fasteners at the display bezel in zone 241. 6. Fit the support bracket under the display unit D4520115601387. 7. Wait two minutes after power-down, then disconnect the two display connectors and put a protective cap on each one. 8. Take the display unit clear and put it in the transit container. 9. Do a general visual inspection of the aperture and of the silicone edging AES4363-5C. 10. Check the terminal display 626TM and the maintenance antenna 72TN for correct indication with the display removed. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT TO SERVICE WITH THE DISPLAY APERTURE OPEN. THE FLIGHT DECK PANEL LOSES ITS SMOKE BARRIER.
sections.close_out: Fit the blanking plate if the replacement display is not to be installed in the same shift. Record the configuration read reference and the removed unit serial number on the aircraft work card. Keep the connector caps in place. Confirm that the maintenance system remains accessible through the maintenance terminal while the display is out.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft with the flight deck display installed. One disconnection sequence applies and it is given in step 7.

safety_precautions: Make the aircraft electrically safe before you disconnect the display.
Protect the flight deck panel surfaces.
Do not release the aircraft with the display aperture open.

title: Removal of the Central Maintenance System Flight Deck Display Unit

issue.reason: Task effectivity split by display standard, with a separate disconnection sequence, connector count and discharge wait for each.

abstract: Removal of the central maintenance system display unit at the third occupant station, in two variants by display standard, including the configuration read that must be taken before the unit is disconnected.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the central maintenance system display unit at the third occupant station, for replacement or for access to the panel behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: Establish the display standard from the aircraft configuration record before you plan the task. The two standards look identical behind the bezel and are not removed the same way: the initial unit has two connectors and is safe to disconnect two minutes after power-down, the higher resolution unit has three, the third of which carries the backlight supply, and its inverter needs ten minutes to discharge. Take the maintenance system configuration read before either unit is disconnected; the display holds the local display configuration and it cannot be recovered from the replacement unit. Stow the third occupant seat and protect the flight deck panel surfaces, which mark easily. Use the support bracket rather than holding the unit at arm's length while the connectors come off.
sections.procedure: 1. Make the aircraft electrically safe and confirm that the maintenance system is powered down. 2. Stow the third occupant seat and protect the adjacent panel surfaces. 3. Connect the maintenance terminal and read the display configuration. 4. Save the configuration read to the operator maintenance system. CAUTION: DO NOT DISCONNECT THE DISPLAY BEFORE THE CONFIGURATION READ IS SAVED. THE LOCAL DISPLAY CONFIGURATION CANNOT BE RECOVERED FROM THE REPLACEMENT UNIT. 5. Release the quarter-turn fasteners at the display bezel in zone 241 and identify the display standard from the label on the upper edge of the unit. 6. Fit the support bracket under the display unit D4520115601387. 7. On a pre MOD-165240 aircraft, follow sequence 1: wait two minutes after power-down, disconnect the two connectors in the order marked on the bracket and cap each one. 8. On a post MOD-165240 aircraft, follow sequence 2: wait ten minutes after power-down for the backlight inverter to discharge, disconnect the backlight supply connector first, then the two data connectors, and cap all three. WARNING: DO NOT DISCONNECT THE BACKLIGHT SUPPLY OF THE HIGHER RESOLUTION DISPLAY BEFORE THE TEN MINUTE DISCHARGE PERIOD HAS ELAPSED. THE INVERTER HOLDS A CHARGE AND THE UNIT CAN BE DAMAGED OR THE TECHNICIAN INJURED. 9. Take the display unit clear and put it in the transit container. 10. Do a general visual inspection of the aperture and of the silicone edging AES4363-5C. 11. Check the terminal display 626TM, the maintenance antenna 72TN and, on a post MOD-165240 aircraft, the terminal control panel 169TN8 for correct indication with the display removed. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT TO SERVICE WITH THE DISPLAY APERTURE OPEN. THE FLIGHT DECK PANEL LOSES ITS SMOKE BARRIER.
sections.close_out: Fit the blanking plate if the replacement display is not to be installed in the same shift. Record the configuration read reference, the removed unit serial number and the sequence used on the aircraft work card. Keep the connector caps in place; the three-connector unit must not be shipped with the backlight supply pin exposed. Confirm that the maintenance system remains accessible through the maintenance terminal while the display is out.

type_data.effectivity_note: Pre MOD-165240 aircraft: the initial display unit, two connectors, two minute discharge wait, disconnection sequence 1. Post MOD-165240 aircraft: the higher resolution unit, three connectors including the backlight supply, ten minute discharge wait, disconnection sequence 2. The sequences are not interchangeable and applying sequence 1 to the higher resolution unit risks the unit and the technician.

safety_precautions: Make the aircraft electrically safe before you disconnect the display.
Protect the flight deck panel surfaces.
Do not release the aircraft with the display aperture open.
